I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread under your message.

The only date I found is in Moss's public Coastal digest from 2 Nov 2025. It says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That was written the night before, so 3 Nov 2025 is the planned handover date, not a confirmed one. I couldn't find a record confirming it: the accounts folder isn't visible to me, and the later digests don't mention the change. Moss or Kwame could confirm the actual date.
